sentences.text: No: for this case, a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges on an existing floating rate term loan sanctioned before December 31, 2025 to an individual for a purpose other than business.
The bank's own Key Facts Statement also says "Pre-payment / foreclosure charges Nil."

The home loan agreement text says a pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding on foreclosure or pre-payment, and a copy says 3%, but those in-force contract terms conflict with the applicable RBI direction.
